repairs.prompt: Create a scientifically grounded educational watercolor illustration of ONE Apatosaurus in complete side profile on a white background. Wide horizontal composition within a square canvas, ample white clearance around every body part. Apatosaurus anatomy: bulky heavy barrel torso, long thick muscular neck projecting forward almost horizontally, small low elongated head, four stout column-like legs with hindlegs similar in length to forelegs, and an exceptionally LONG TAIL extending backwards for AT LEAST the combined head-neck-torso length, tapering into a delicate whip tip. Keep tail nearly horizontal and fully visible; entire silhouette should fit across the canvas, use smaller scale to fit, never shorten the tail. No horns, no armour, no upright neck, no dorsal plates. Muted gray-brown skin as speculative life restoration. No text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark. Accuracy more important than cuteness.

repairs.review: 太い長い首・小さな頭・重い四足の体・胴体より長い先細りの尾を確認。全身と尾の先まで保持。体色は復元上の表現。

repairs.prompt: One educational watercolor illustration of a classic French folded omelette on a plain white ceramic plate, pure white background, ample white margins, no text or watermark. A golden smooth plump crescent oval made by folding a SINGLE layer of beaten egg over soft creamy cooked egg inside. One small cut opening at the end reveals soft irregular creamy egg curds, NOT concentric layers. Clearly a fluffy folded omelette, no spiral, no rolled layers, no rectangular tamagoyaki, no omelet rice, no filling other than egg. Natural golden yellow, appetizing simple food icon consistent with Japanese children's watercolor picture-book dictionary illustrations. Entire plate and food fully visible.
